items.summary: FPL announced Monday night it met its revised restoration target: more than 380,000 outages restored as of 10 p.m. CDT (85%+ of the 435,000 customers impacted by Hurricane Isaias), restoration essentially complete in 6 of 8 counties, and all critical infrastructure facilities plus schools scheduled to open Tuesday restored. Crews remain on track to essentially complete restoration in the hardest-hit Escambia and Santa Rosa counties by end of day Tuesday. ~17,000 restoration workers deployed from 29 states; 480+ drone/helicopter damage-assessment flights. 10+ customer outage relief stations open (ice, water, restoration answers). Single-sourced (FPL's own release; corroboration search surfaced only FPL's own newsroom - PNJ's latest figures are 4:30 PM Monday and consistent with the trajectory).
items.title: FPL: >85% of Isaias customers restored Monday night (380,000+), 6 of 8 counties essentially complete

items.summary: NHC Intermediate Advisory 23A (~10:48 PM PDT): Hurricane Simon holds at Category 2, 100 mph, but central pressure rose to 977 mb (from 969 mb in Advisory 23) - a weakening trend; ~90 mi W of Cabo Corrientes, now moving NW at 3 mph. No new watches/warnings: hurricane warning Las Islas Marias; tropical storm watch Cabo Corrientes to Escuinapa; hurricane watch Escuinapa to Bahia Tempehuaya. Forecast: 80 mph Tuesday, re-intensifying to ~100 mph Thu-Fri near the west-central Mexico coast, post-tropical by Saturday. Mexico SMN's 21:00 CDT bulletin (verified via CONAGUA/CNPC posts) is consistent: Cat 2, 155 km/h (96 mph), 135 km W of Cabo Corrientes, 315 km S of Mazatlan, WNW 6 km/h; heavy to very heavy rain for western Jalisco, coastal Nayarit, southern Sinaloa.
items.title: Simon Advisory 23A: still Cat 2 (100 mph), pressure up to 977 mb; moving NW

items.summary: TV Azteca Sinaloa documented heavy rain falling in Mazatlan Monday night as Simon's outer effects arrive ahead of the forecast Wed-Thu coastal approach (on-screen: 'LLUVIAS POR SIMON' / 'Comienzan las primeras lluvias en Mazatlan por el huracan Simon'). First verified on-the-ground weather impact in Mazatlan from this storm. Image: reused verified Simon satellite photo (image-search results for Mazatlan rain were unusable: unrelated/2018-Hurricane-Willa or wrong-storm images).
items.title: First Simon-linked rains begin in Mazatlan (TV Azteca Sinaloa)
